name: python-segment-tree
title: Segment Tree
blurb: A segment tree over an integer array with the combine as the seam: every window answer equals the matching slice sum exactly, a rebuild from the leaf row equals the build it came from, and no query visits more than twice the bit-length of the array.
default_description: A segment tree over an integer array whose every window answer equals the matching slice sum, under any fold you hand it.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
